facts.statement: A community event held an open duel at the Briarheart Warpstone on Friday December 4th, on Server 1, open to all levels and jobs.
facts.quote: we’re having an open duel at the Briarheart Warpstone

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A SOE community event post announcing an open player-vs-player duel at the Briarheart Warpstone on Friday December 4th, held on Server 1 in two time slots (US/Latin America and UK/Europe). It also explains how to start a duel: select the 'Duel' option from another player's radial menu, and the accepting player is moved to a private dueling area. The post's date is not shown; it says it was posted 1 week, 3 days before capture.
